outline.heading: What a plan is made of

points.text: The plan of the first step gathers everything you did in the course: the form of the meeting (lesson 04/u1); the date and how many people; whom to invite and why (04/u2); which steps of the method go into the meeting (02/u3); how to tell current clients and who stays one to one (04/u3); the sign that the step worked.

outline.heading: The sign that the step worked

points.text: The sign is named before the meeting, not after.
The format ladder page has a “My map” block.
The leader's plan: “Small group: breath and back”.
The first step is put into the week, not left waiting for room to appear.

points: You name the sign before the meeting instead of after it.
The leader has a plan for a small group focused on breath and back.
You put the first step into your week instead of waiting for room to appear.
